items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: Well, he had been in town quite a while, you know, because him and Luz Demere was good friends until he formed this band.

ctx.x: How long has Landry been in town? Did you know where he was from or anything?

Landry was from Donisonville. That's his home. Well, he had been in town quite a while, you know, because him and Luz Demere was good friends until he formed this band. Well, I was playing out Millenboy at a nightclub. Well, I had charge of the job. And Rodgers was drumming with me and he told me he used to call me No, he used to call me Dago. He said, Dago, say, how about you come get in the brass band with us? I said, well, I don't know. I said, I don't have no experience in that. I was just, you know, just…
There's one thing we always forget to ask people about their school, where they went to school when they were a kid. I don't remember if you told.
